reuse.why: No existing duplicate-link check existed; the change adds one helper beside the link functions and uses the existing db.first access pattern.

duplication.why: The rule lives once in assertBankAccountNotLinked; only a short guard call is repeated in each of the five already-duplicated provider link functions.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers, before findOrCreateBank and any write or sync, which is where this tree performs link logic.

scope.why: Only the helper, five guard calls, an import and a dedicated test file are added.

maintainability.why: A single named, parameterised guard is easy to own; a future sixth provider must remember to call it since the link functions are still separate copies.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all five link*Account handlers
